author: mgallagher56
body:
Fixes the audit findings for mortgage estimates, copy, budget ownership, the saved profile hook, mutation survivors and existence-only test assertions. Items 8 and 9 (the functionality map and AGENTS.md) were dropped on the coordinator's instruction: the map is being cut back to route level in a separate PR. This PR does not touch `docs/system/functionality-map/` or `AGENTS.md`.

## Changes

- **LTV band** (`mortgage-affordability.ts`): `resolveLtvBandFromDeposit` now returns the matched `band`. It used to call `lookupMortgageRateBandForLtv(ltvPct)` again, which could pick a lower band (for example £1,000, 300 months, £45,030 deposit gave 70-80% rates while highLtvPct was 80.1%).
- **Rate table date** (`LoanFromPaymentTool.tsx`): the helper text and the stale-rate notice build "November 2026" from `MORTGAGE_RATE_TABLE_AS_OF`.
- **Saved term** (`MortgageEstimatesContainer.tsx`): the term now comes from the new engine function `resolveEstimateTermMonths` (E39 4c). It uses saved months as saved (235 stays 235, not 240), then years x 12, then `DEFAULT_ESTIMATE_TERM_MONTHS` (300). The 25-year default now lives in the engine. The term slider shows up to two decimals for a part-year term, for example 19.58.
- **Copy**: the heading reads "November in brief", with no full stop.
- **BudgetEditor**: a row or shared rent that was joint keeps its ownership field after it is saved as sole with partner mode off, in line with d9a4a5eef.
- **`useSavedProfile`**: removed the try/catch and its `biome-ignore`. The hook now needs a data router. Storybook already mocks `useRouteLoaderData`. The consistency test's react-router mock gains `useRouteLoaderData`.
- **AccountsContainer**: reads `partnerMode` from `useSavedProfile()` instead of casting the loader's `userProfile`.
- **Mobile parity**: added a row to the E12 log for the check-in heading and ownership field changes.

## Tests

- LTV band: hand-worked boundary test (£45,030 deposit, matched 90% band). It failed before the fix, which returned the 80% band. A second hand-worked test puts LTV exactly on 80% (£1,001, £45,439.16 deposit). It fails when `<=` is changed to `<`.
- `resolveEstimateTermMonths`: hand-worked cases for months, years x 12, the default, and Infinity/NaN/negative input. In the container, a saved term of 235 months shows 19.58 years in the slider pill and in the rate tool. This failed before the fix, showing 20.
- BudgetEditor: joint row saved as sole stays mounted and can switch back; shared rent with partner mode off and on; a rent that was never joint shows no field. Two of these failed before the fix.
- Review follow-up: the loan note shows a part-year term as 19.58 (235 / 12 = 19.5833...), not 19.583333333333332. The test fails without the formatting.
- `formatMonthInBrief`: heading and facts. Updated the CheckInSummary text assertions.
- AccountsContainer: partner mode on and off, read from the root loader data.
- Mutation testing (AGENTS 17), single-file Stryker on `invoicing/index.ts`, `mortgage-affordability.ts`, `mortgage-rate-assumptions.ts`, `mortgage.ts:345-364,447-461` and `housing-room.ts`:
  - First run: 90 survivors. Final run: 26 of 628, all equivalent, each with a row in `docs/testing/mutation-triage.md`.
  - `invoicing/index.ts` and `housing-room.ts` are now at 100%.
  - New tests cover the CSV error labels, an undefined VAT rate, the `parseYearMonth` pattern edges, each bad mortgage input on its own, and the unknown-path reasons and safe-to-spend commitments in housing room.
- Existence-only assertions: replaced 21 `toBeDefined`/`toBeTruthy` checks added in #865, #867, #873, #884 and #885 with value or state assertions: select and input values, full banner text, status role, body text and KPI counts.
- No test was weakened, skipped or removed. The string-term case in the engine test became an Infinity case because `SavedMortgageTermInput` now takes numbers only.
- Local runs: `bun run lint`, `bun run check-types` and `bun run check:laws` pass. Ran vitest on the changed files in finance-engine, web and marketing, plus `vitest related app/hooks/useUserProfile.ts` (all pass). The full suite, build, Storybook a11y and E2E were not run locally and are left to CI. No file went over 5 seconds.

## Guard changes

- Removed one `biome-ignore lint/correctness/useHookAtTopLevel` suppression in `apps/web/app/hooks/useUserProfile.ts`. The coordinator asked for this as a task item. It removes a suppression and adds none.
- No allow-list, limit, baseline or required check changed.

## Review

Independent review by a separate opus subagent: LTV fix recomputed by hand, 7 triage rows spot-checked as equivalent, 21 assertions confirmed real. Could not verify: tests, lint and Stryker not re-run by the reviewer; Storybook rendering after the hook change; term slider with a fractional value.
